newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent crude softer in dull market.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent crude softer in dull market.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures were quoted lower in a very quiet market ahead of the Eid-al Adha public holiday, brokers said on Thursday.
But the market would remain open on Friday.
June was bid at $17.65 per barrel with no offers seen, while July was unquoted.

June settled lower in London on Wednesday at $17.81, breaking the previous supprt of $17.90, due to soft U.S. gasoline demand which sent New York markets diving as well as a build in U.S. crude stocks last week.
NYMEX crude on ACCESS also suffered on the bearish fundamentals, to last trade at $19.33, down two cents from its last official close.
